_comment: Does this style paint OVER the mouth or UNDER it? It cannot be inferred from coverage — a moustache overlaps the mouth region by 34% and must go over, stubble by 78% and must go under, and there is no clean cut between them. It is a property of the style, so it is declared here once rather than guessed per render.
_over: the hair hangs over the lip: the mouth is drawn first and the hair covers its top edge
_under: the hair is a mass the mouth sits in: the mouth is drawn last, on top, so it is never hidden
